fullPassage: A key to engagement and achievement is providing students with relevant texts they will be interested in. My scholarly work and my teaching have been deeply influenced by the work of Rosalie Fink. She interviewed twelve adults who were highly successful in their work, including a physicist, a biochemist, and a company CEO. All of them had dyslexia and had had significant problems with reading throughout their school years. While she expected to find that they had avoided reading and discovered ways to bypass it or compensate with other strategies for learning, she found the opposite. "To my surprise, I found that these dyslexics were enthusiastic readers...they rarely avoided reading. On the contrary, they sought out books." The pattern Fink discovered was that all of her subjects had been passionate in some personal interest. The areas of interest included religion, math, business, science, history, and biography. What mattered was that they read voraciously to find out more.

det.analysis: passion(명사: 열정) → passionate(형용사: 열정적인). 'had been ___'에서 be동사 뒤 보어 자리라 형용사가 필요해요. 명사 passion에 -ate를 붙여 형용사 passionate로 바꿔요. '개인적 관심사에 열정적이었다'는 뜻이에요.
det.tip: passion(명사) + -ate → passionate(형용사). be동사 뒤 보어 자리엔 형용사

questions.passage: A key to engagement and achievement is providing students with relevant texts they will be interested in. My scholarly work and my teaching have been deeply influenced by the work of Rosalie Fink. She interviewed twelve adults who were highly successful in their work, including a physicist, a biochemist, and a company CEO. All of them had dyslexia and had had __________ with reading throughout their school years. While she expected to find that they had avoided reading and discovered ways to bypass it or compensate with other strategies for learning, she found the opposite. "To my surprise, I found that these dyslexics were enthusiastic readers...they rarely avoided reading. On the contrary, they sought out books." The pattern Fink discovered was that all of her subjects had been passionate in some personal interest. The areas of interest included religion, math, business, science, history, and biography. What mattered was that they read voraciously to find out more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① significant problems(상당한 문제): 난독증으로 학창 시절 내내 읽기에 큰 어려움을 겪음 ←정답
② lasting friendships(지속적인 우정): 문맥 무관
③ sudden interest(갑작스러운 흥미): 문맥 무관
④ general agreement(전반적인 동의): 문맥 무관
det.tip: had dyslexia and had had significant problems with reading = 난독증으로 읽기에 상당한 문제를 겪음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① financial reward(금전적 보상): 뒤에 종교·수학·역사 등 관심 '분야'가 이어지므로 부적절
② personal interest(개인적 관심사): 모든 대상자가 어떤 개인적 관심사에 열정적이었음 ←정답
③ social pressure(사회적 압력): 문맥 무관
④ academic degree(학위): 문맥 무관
det.tip: passionate in some personal interest = 어떤 개인적 관심사에 열정적인
